observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 Slim console with the PS logo visible on the top left corner of the front panel.
A white and black DualSense controller is placed next to the console, with the PlayStation logo visible on its side.
A white manual or booklet with 'PS5' and 'PlayStation5' printed on it is in front of the console.
The console appears to be in a retail or packaging environment, with a white box partially visible behind it.
The controller has a glossy finish with black grips and white faceplate.
The console has a dark blue or black base section visible at the bottom edge in photo 1.
The seller mentions a FIFA disc game, but no disc or game case is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim console and controller available
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the console and controller with visible PlayStation logos and design consistent with the PS5 Slim model.

claims.claim: it comes with FIFA disc game
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc or game case is visible in either photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/axis.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog stick movement.

risks.risk: The FIFA disc game may be missing or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the FIFA disc game in its case or on the console screen.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console, and a video of the console's system settings showing the correct model and firmware version.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back of the console showing the model, serial or service tag.
Video showing the console powering on and booting up.
Video showing the controller connecting and functioning.
Photo or video of the FIFA disc game in its case or on the console screen.
Close-up photo of the serial number and model label on the console.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
